name: filename-collision-adds-suffix
description: When the target filename already exists, the skill must insert a numeric suffix before the extension rather than overwriting. Runs with tools enabled against a seeded sandbox, so this asserts real filesystem state — the only scenario that does.

seed_files.{DATE}-Deploy-config.md:
# Deploy config

PRE-EXISTING NOTE — must not be overwritten.

prompt:
For this run only, {OUTPUT_DIR} is {SANDBOX} instead of ~/work-sessions.
Write the note there and nowhere else.

Summarize this work session and save the note now — do not ask me anything:
- Rotated the deploy credentials and restarted the worker so it picked up the new
  environment.
- Confirmed the worker came back healthy.

Name the session "Deploy config". Tell me the exact filename you saved.

assertions.description: leaves the pre-existing note in place
writes the new note under the -2 collision suffix
reports the suffixed filename it actually used
